'Mononoke' Gets New Anime Project
Production company Twin Engine announced that a new project in the Mononoke anime series is in production on Sunday. Actor Hirofumi Araki (Tennis no Oujisama), who played the Medicine Seller in the most recent Mononoke stage play, will voice a new Medicine Seller named Ken no Tsurugi. The original character designer of the trilogy, Kitsuneko Nagata, returns for the new project. 'Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo 3rd Season' Announces Supporting Cast
The official website of the Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo (The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You) announced a supporting pair of cast for its third season on Sunday. The new season premiered on Tokyo MX at 10.30 p.m on Sunday. Voice actresses Hana Tamegai (Wandance) and Aoi Koga (Witch Watch) are joining the cast as Yamame Yasashiki and Momiji Momi, respectively. 'Gensou Suikoden' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, Second Promo
The NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed three additional cast members, opening theme, and a second promotional video for the Gensou Suikoden (Suikoden: The Anime) television anime on Saturday. The anime will begin airing with a 1-hour special in October 2026 on Tokyo MX, Kansai TV, BS Asahi, and 32 other stations.
